title: Flesh-eating screwworms spread in the US
excerpt: Parasitic flies have reached a third state, with USDA identifying 74 animal cases including pets.
body_html:
Flesh-eating screwworms have expanded their reach to a third US state, with parasitic flies increasingly targeting pets. The United States Department of Agriculture has recorded a total of 74 animal cases across the country since the flies first invaded in June.

Recent infections include attacks on four dogs and a cat within a single week. Officials continue to monitor the spread of the parasites as the total number of affected animals rises.
